item.title: Judge: Baltimore ICE hold rooms violated Fifth Amendment, orders immediate limits on detainees
item.description: A federal judge ruled that Baltimore's ICE office must limit detainees at the George Fallon Building after court documents alleged unconstitutional overcrowding and poor conditions.

item.title: Baltimore Goes All-In: Ravens acquire Pro Bowl DE Maxx Crosby
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens have acquired Pro Bowl defensive end Maxx Crosby from the Las Vegas Raiders in exchange for two first-round picks.

item.title: University of Maryland professor grows lab-made fibroids to find better treatments for patients
item.description: A UMD professor is growing lab-made fibroids to study how they form and find less invasive treatments for the millions of women affected.
